areas.name: Everyday
areas.blurb: The small sums you do standing in an aisle.

areas.name: Writing
areas.blurb: Catch the thought, then make it readable.

areas.name: Sport & Exercise
areas.blurb: Count the rounds. Know the pace.

areas.name: Trades
areas.blurb: How much to buy, and where to cut it.

areas.name: Kitchen
areas.blurb: Scale the recipe, watch the pans.

areas.name: Money
areas.blurb: What it really costs, and who owes what.

areas.name: Study
areas.blurb: Remember it, and sit still long enough to learn it.

areas.name: Health
areas.blurb: Quiet daily records that add up.

areas.name: Travel
areas.blurb: Pack it, and get the hour right.

areas.name: Home
areas.blurb: Keep the plants alive and the boxes labelled.

flows.name: Unit Price
flows.blurb: Put two or three sizes in and it tells you the price per litre, per kilo, per sheet — and which one wins.

flows.name: Split the Bill
flows.blurb: A total, a number of people, an optional tip — and the awkward bit where someone had the lobster.

flows.name: Idea Board
flows.blurb: Type the thought, tag it, let it sit. Sort by tag when you are ready to make something of them.

flows.name: Plain English
flows.tagline: Find the sentence nobody can follow
flows.blurb: Paste anything. It marks the long sentences, the passive voice and the words with shorter cousins.

flows.name: Interval Timer
flows.blurb: Set the rounds and the two clocks. It counts down loudly enough to hear from the floor.

flows.name: Pace
flows.blurb: Fill any two and it solves the third, then lays out even splits for the whole distance.

flows.name: Materials
flows.blurb: Paint, tiles, concrete, decking, turf. Give it the dimensions and it gives you the order, waste included.

flows.name: Cut List
flows.blurb: Your stock lengths and the pieces you need. It packs them, counts the bars and shows the waste.

flows.name: Recipe Scaler
flows.blurb: Paste the ingredients, change the servings, and every quantity moves with it — cups to grams if you want.

flows.name: Kitchen Timers
flows.blurb: Named timers running side by side, so the rice and the roast stop being the same problem.

flows.name: Repayments
flows.tagline: What it costs to borrow it
flows.blurb: Amount, rate, term. See the repayment, the total interest, and what one extra payment a month does to it.

flows.name: Who Owes What
flows.blurb: Log who paid for what on a trip or a share house, and it works out the fewest payments that square it.

flows.name: Cards
flows.tagline: The ones you keep missing come back
flows.blurb: Flashcards with a memory. Get one right and it waits longer; get it wrong and it is back tomorrow.

flows.name: Focus
flows.blurb: A working clock with breaks built in, and a quiet log of the sessions you actually finished.

flows.name: Streak
flows.blurb: A handful of daily habits, one tap each, and a year of squares that makes the gaps obvious.

flows.name: Sleep Log
flows.tagline: Two taps a day, a month of evidence
flows.blurb: Bed time, wake time. It keeps the hours, the average and the nights that broke the pattern.

flows.name: Packing
flows.blurb: Start from a trip template — beach, snow, work, camping — then tick your way out the door.

flows.name: Time Zones
flows.blurb: Line up three or four places and drag a bar through the day to find the window nobody hates.

flows.name: Plant Care
flows.blurb: Every plant with its own interval. It tells you what needs water now and remembers when you last did it.

flows.name: Home Inventory
flows.tagline: What you own, and where it is
flows.blurb: Room by room: what it was worth, when the warranty runs out, which box it went into.
